findings.summary: `build()` (and therefore `check()`, which calls it) always runs `lessons_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`, so the read-only `index.py check` (and `lesson_and_eval`'s call to it) creates `lessons/` as a side effect even when it only reports drift or failure; carried over from the prior review round (owner's fix-requests.json item 7, explicitly deferred to 0.3.7, still present at this HEAD).
findings.rule: doubt stated: low impact (an untracked empty directory is never committed), but every other gate check in plugin/gate/checks.py is read-only on the filesystem

findings.summary: `_render_line`'s `Tags:` clause joins the raw `fm["tags"]` list as the author wrote it, while the heading grouping uses `normalise_class(e.tags[0])`; an unnormalised class (e.g. "Flaky Test") renders under heading `## flaky-test` with a line that still reads `Tags: Flaky Test, ...`, inconsistent with the spec's determinism bullet ("Tags: class, metric, runbook" is meant to be the normalised class); owner's fix-requests.json item 5, explicitly deferred to 0.3.7.
findings.rule: doubt stated: owner already triaged this as can-wait; spec.md's determinism bullet is the rule it falls short of

findings.summary: `_render_line`/`_render_unsorted_line` interpolate `title`/`description`/the first heading into a markdown link with no escaping, so a value containing `]` or `(` would break the generated link in `lessons/index.md`; carried over unaddressed from the prior review round's findings for commit 37e2dfad6c.
findings.rule: doubt stated: spec.md's determinism bullet does not call for escaping, and no source file or test exercises such a title today
